name: Noether
role: Jakarta Persistence 3.2 implementation, extracted from Mansart (in development, not released yet)
preambleHtml: Noether implements Jakarta Persistence 3.2 with strict Java Modules, generated entity access and virtual-thread JDBC execution. Its provisional Validation provider is a local test/TCK stopgap, not a complete implementation.
originHtml:
Origin of the name

The project honours Emmy Noether (1882–1935), the German mathematician whose work reshaped abstract algebra and established the connection between symmetries and conservation laws.
